newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Court keeps "directly concerned" test narrow.
newsitem.headline: Court keeps "directly concerned" test narrow.

text.p: The European Court of First Instance dismissed on Tuesday claims from French based trading groups Dreyfus and Companie Continentale and Bermuda based Richco Commodities against the Commission, as inadmissible.

In four separate but related cases, the court found the applicants did not have standing to challenge the Commission's authority to oversee contracts concluded between the companies and state trading organizations based in the former Soviet Union.

The court applied the "directly concerned" test under article 173 of the EC Treaty and found none of the impacted companies should have relied on contracts with former Soviet Republics which were not first found by the Commission to have met the Community's conditions for trade there.
The food and medical contracts were designed to aid the former republics after the fall of the USSR and were governed by Council decision 91/658/EEC.
EXCERPTS FROM THE JUDGMENTS
(Court translation into French. Original language of the case: Dutch)
24 septembre 1996
Dans l'affaire T-491/93
"Assistance d'urgence de la Communaute aux Etats de l'ex-Union sovietique - Appel d'offres - Recours en annulation - Recevabilite - Recours en indemnite - Recevabilite"
Richco Commodities Ltd, partie requerante
contre
Commission des Communautes europeennes, partie defenderesse,

ayant pour objet, d'une part, une demande d'annulation de la decision de la Commission du 1er avril 1993 adressee a la Vnesheconombank, d'autre part, la reparation des dommages prendument subis par la requerante en raison de la decision litigieuse
LE TRIBUNAL declare et arrete
1. Le recours en annulation est rejete comme irrecevable.
2. L'exception d'irrecvabilite est rejetee pour autant qu'elle concerne la demande tendant a la reparatio du prejudice allegue par la requerante.
3. La procedure relative a cette demand en reparation sera poursuivie au fond.
4. Les depens sont reserves.
(Court translation into French. Original language of the case: Dutch)
DANS L'AFFAIRE T-509/93
"Assistance d'urgence de la Communaute aux Etats de l'ex-Union sovietique - Appel d'offres - Recours en annulation - Recevabilite"
Richco Commodities Ltd, partie requerante
contre
Commission des Communautes europeennes, partie defenderesse
ayant pour objet une demande d'annulation de la decision de la Commission du 12 juillet 1993 adressee a la State Export-Import Bank of Ukraine
LE TRIBUNAL declare et arrete:
1. Le recours est rejete comme irrecevable.
2. La requerante est condamnee aux depens.
